title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: Nasdaq nears one-month low as debt worries deepen AI stock selloff - The Economic Times
text: Dow Jones Today | US Stock Market Live: The Nasdaq fell to near one-month lows on Thursday as fears of a hit to artificial-intelligence investments from higher interest rates deepened a rout in AI-linked stocks, while fresh data confirmed price pressures building in the US economy.
